Subject: Request: guest host trial stipend for EdgeML Live (April 6)

Hey Logan,

Thanks again for sponsoring EdgeML Live on April 6 — super excited to have Redwood on the stage. A quick ask from our events ops: several of our guest hosts (influencers + partner engineers) need short-term trial access so they can demo integrations live.

Can Redwood provide a small pool of trial credits that we can distribute to hosts? Specifically were proposing: 25 "guest" trials (30 days, full API access, capped at 100k tokens each) to be used by invited speakers and partner engineers only. Wed like the credits issued as one-time promo codes and ideally tied to the EdgeStack SOW for audit.

Attached is the guest list (emails) and the SOW for context. Happy to sign any lightweight MSA addendum if needed.

Would appreciate confirmation by EOD Wednesday so we can finalize speaker comms.

Best,
Maria
